summary: Round 9 live verification: 51/51 backend HTTP checks pass and full frontend UX pass. Turnstile public-state anon returns {state,code,site_key,degraded_login} (no 'enabled' key), state=disabled. Governed break-glass lifecycle (activate -> readiness ok=false -> deactivate -> review empty=400 review_note_required -> review with note -> readiness ok=true) works end-to-end and record left clean. Authority decision/inventory return correct schema, dominance list, new_exposure_allowed consistent (state=CLOSE_ONLY, nea=false). /api/authority root returns embedded decision with matching state and enforced_level==level. Register invariant: two calls with same brand-new email both return 200 with identical exact keys {id,email,name,email_verified,message}, no activation_email_sent/error keys, timing ~equal (0.83s/0.83s). Release readiness contains turnstile_break_glass, turnstile_config, canonical_decision(state), inventory(counts), rc_lock(present true, ok true). Frontend: /login has no turnstile-status element and submit is enabled; /register submit disabled until data-testid=register-terms-checkbox is checked. Post-login dashboard shows data-testid=authority-strip with decision-state='CLOSE ONLY' + decision-code='TERMINAL_STALE'; drilldown-toggle reveals drilldown with authority-blocker-TERMINAL_STALE. Strip state matches GET /api/authority/decision (CLOSE_ONLY).
critical_code_review_comments: Non-admin 403 path for /api/authority/inventory/expectation is only reachable by verified users; without seeding a verified regular user, this branch cannot be exercised in preview without a DB write. Consider a preview-only seeded verified non-admin user for QA.
seed_data_creation: Registered qa-r9-<hex>@example.com twice for register invariant + non-admin 403 test; DB row deleted after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/round9_live_test.py as regression. CSRF is enforced when cookie-auth is present; call GET /api/auth/csrf after login and forward the csrf_token cookie as x-csrf-token header for any POST/PUT/DELETE. For non-admin 403 tests, either seed a verified user via Mongo or flip email_verified=True after registration.
